title.zh: A crypto project paying nearly 1 million people a daily income just had its reserves looted
title.en: A crypto project paying nearly 1 million people a daily income just had its reserves looted

current_state.zh: A Superfluid bug on Celo allowed an attacker to mint excess G$ and drain over $100,000 from GoodDollar's reserves, threatening the liquidity backing its daily income program for nearly 1 million users.
current_state.en: A Superfluid bug on Celo allowed an attacker to mint excess G$ and drain over $100,000 from GoodDollar's reserves, threatening the liquidity backing its daily income program for nearly 1 million users.
